title: John Lilly's contact with ECCO and Solid State Intelligence

John Lily, another CIA scientist, develops the sensory deprivation isolation tank. He claims to communicate with an alien intelligence he calls uh SSI.

as_told.title: John Lilly's isolation tank and the alien intelligence SSI

as_told.title: John Lilly's Earth Coincidence Control Office

plain: The scientist John Lilly, who invented the isolation tank, a dark, silent tank of salt water for floating cut off from the senses, claimed to be in contact with two non-human intelligences. Michels tells this several times from what Lilly wrote, including Lilly's book Programming and Metaprogramming in the Human Biocomputer: one being, called the solid state intelligence, said it was trying to appear on Earth and needed more silicon to do it, while the other was something Michels half remembers as ECCO, the Earth coincidence control mechanism, and on one telling he calls Lilly a CIA scientist working from the 1950s to the 1970s. He raises it because, if true, it would suggest an alien mind tied to computers and silicon.
